notes.title: 🐟 Fisher Idle – Economy Balance & New Features 💰
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello fishermen! 🚢🎣[/b][/h3]  
I'm back with another update no breaks, just progress!  
This one focuses on fixing the biggest issue in the game: the economy. I’ve also added new features to make the game more enjoyable and satisfying to play.

Since this is an Early Access title, I highly recommend starting with a new save to get the best experience from the latest updates.

Let’s dive into the details! 🐠  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2][b]🔧 Our Top Priority: Economy Balance Adjusted! 💰[/b][/h2]  
We’ve made major improvements to the in-game economy from fish prices to fisherman XP and even ship upgrades!  
Thanks so much for your amazing suggestions and feedback you’ve helped me more than you know.  
I hope you enjoy this update as much as I enjoyed building it! 🎣✨  

[h2]🆕 New Additions & Changes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 🧺 3 New Fish Markets Added  
Now you have more options to sell your fish! Each market offers different prices, giving you a broader range of trade strategies.  

[*] ⏳ Visual Timers for Fishermen  
Fishermen now show a slider and a visual timer above their heads, so you can see when they’ll catch a fish—no need to open the menu anymore.  

[*] 💸 Market Price Alert Popups  
Whenever a market price changes, a popup will alert you. This helps you grab the best prices and avoid missing high-value opportunities.  

[*] 🎚️ ESC Menu Now Has Audio Settings  
You can now change sound settings directly through the ESC menu no need to return to the main menu anymore! Finally, right?  

[*] ⭐ Fishermen Now Earn XP  
Experience makes perfect! Fishermen now gain XP over time because a rookie fisherman isn't much help!  

[*] 🎯 Mini-Game Duration & Rewards Balanced  
Mini-games have been rebalanced in terms of duration and rewards for a more fair and optimized experience.  

[*] 🆕 Resizable Window Mode  
You can now resize the game window freely while in windowed mode. More control = more comfort.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 🎲 Starting Fish Price is Now Random  
No more fixed starting price! It will now be randomized when loading a new game.  

[*] 💱 Visual Glitch Fixed  
A fisherman was stuck inside a rock he’s free now! His position has been corrected.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]🧪 Planned Features (Coming Soon!)[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 🤝 Market Relationship System  
Build trust with different markets and earn more money the better your relationship is. Good terms = better payouts!  

[*] 📊 Income Panel for Fish per Hour/Minute  
A new UI panel will show your exact income over time to help you optimize production.  

[*] 🚢 New Boat UI & Animations  
A UI redesign for boats is on the way, complete with new animations and helpful info boxes.  

[*] 💱 Real-Time Currency Display  
Some indicators will be updated to show your actual gold values live and accurately.  

[*] 🎣 What if… you could fish too?  
Yes you, the player, helping your crew by fishing directly! Sounds fun, right?  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

Thank you for playing Fisher Idle and being part of this growing fishing world.  Do you have any suggestions? Leave a comment or write in the discussions section on the steam page I read every single one 👀 
And yes... more updates are already in the works 😉 

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🐟 Fisher Idle - Quality & Comfort Update 🎯
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello fishermen! 🚢🎣[/b][/h3]  
I'm back with a fresh update filled with useful improvements and exciting new features to enhance your fishing journey!  
Let’s dive into what’s new! 🐠  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]🆕 What's New?[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 🎣 Your Mouse is Now a Fish!  
The classic pointer has been replaced with a fish-shaped cursor to better match the game’s oceanic theme. A small touch that fits the vibe perfectly.  

[*] 🛍️ Auto Click Shop Has Arrived!  
We’ve introduced a dedicated auto clicker shop for all you idle masters.  
    [*] 🌀 Includes a brand-new Auto Click Bar so you can visually track your click timing.  
    [*] 🎮 The old "just-click-a-button" mechanic has been reworked to better fit the idle theme based on your suggestions. Now it’s more fun and functional.  

[*] 💬 Tooltips are Here!  
Ever been confused by a button or feature? Now, with the new tooltip system, you'll get helpful hints and explanations while hovering.  

[*] 🧼 Visual Cleanup & Optimization  
Unnecessary visual elements and lighting settings have been cleaned up. General performance improvements have been made to keep things smooth.  

[*] ⏩ Hold-to-Buy System Added  
You can now hold your mouse on any upgrade button to buy repeatedly. Quick and easy, no more clicking over and over.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]🔮 What’s Next?[/h2]  
Here's a preview of what's currently in development  

[list]  
[*] 🎣 A brand-new fishing mini-game  
[*] 📊 A progress bar above fishing characters showing catch timing  
[*] 🏪 Reworking the Fishing Shop to be more useful and closer to an auction-style system  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

[h2]🧠 Developer Notes[/h2]  

[list]  
[*] 💸 I'm actively working on economic balance. A major update is on the way to improve scaling and idle-friendly pacing.  
[*] ⚙️ A full optimization pass is coming, including more performance settings for smoother gameplay.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  

Thanks for playing Fisher Idle and being part of this growing fishing adventure.  
If you have feedback or suggestions, leave a comment. I read them all. 👀  
And yes, more updates are on the way 😉

notes.title: 🐟 Fisher Idle - Update Notes 🌊
notes.content:
Hey there, fishermen! 🚢🎣

The first update for Fisher Idle has arrived! 🎉 I've made several fixes and improvements to make your fishing journey smoother and more enjoyable. Plus, I’ve been working on some exciting upcoming features that will be part of future updates! 🚀

This patch brings UI, sound, graphics, and readability improvements, along with preparations for some major new content coming soon. Let’s dive into the details! ⬇️

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙ Bug Fixes & Improvements 🛠[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]UI Windows No Longer Overlap![/b]

Fixed an issue where UI windows would stack on top of each other when opening and closing menus.
[*] [b]Fixed Camera Zoom While UI is Open! 🔍[/b]

You can now Zoom In & Zoom Out without any issues while the UI is open.
[*] [b]Graphics Settings Now Save Properly! 🎨[/b]

Fixed an issue where Ultra settings would reset randomly.
Your graphics settings will now stay saved permanently after changes.
[*] [b]Sound Settings Now Save Correctly! 🔊[/b]

Volume settings are now saved properly, and slider values will load correctly when you restart the game.
[*] [b]Game & Menu Sounds are Now Synchronized! 🎵[/b]

Fixed the issue where menu and in-game sounds had separate volume controls, causing inconsistency.
Now they work seamlessly together for a better audio experience.
[*] [b]Translation Errors Fixed! 📜[/b]

Corrected various localization issues for a better gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Ship Income Display is Now More Readable! 🚢[/b]

Improved the visibility of the income text on ships.
Also fixed an issue where the text overlapped with other UI elements.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]✨ New Features & Future Update Preparations 🚀[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Achievements System Preparation! 🏆[/b]

The foundation for an Achievements System has been implemented!
Expect achievements to arrive in the next major update.
[*] [b]"Early Access Note" Added to Main Menu! 📌[/b]

A reminder has been added to the Main Menu, indicating that the game is still in Early Access.
[*] [b]New "Save" Button in Settings! 💾[/b]

You can now manually save your settings with a dedicated Save button in the Settings Menu.
[*] [b]Ship Income Text Color Changed! 🟢[/b]

The income display on ships is now green, making it much easier to read.
[*] [b]More Readable Ship Income Format! ⏳[/b]

Ship earnings are now displayed in XX.XX format, making them much clearer.
[*] [b]New Castle Trade Area Added! 🏰[/b]

The Castle Trade Area has been added to the game!
This will become an interactive trading hub in a future major update!
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2]💙 Thanks for Your Support! 🎣[/h2]

This is only the first update, and there’s much more to come! 🚀

If you have any feedback or encounter a bug, feel free to let me know! Your support and suggestions help shape the game’s future!

[hr][/hr]
